summary: The App class library explicitly remains non-listening and without deployment/production authority. The separate orchestration Host is an executable with explicit serve, initialization and diagnostic routes, mandatory configuration/fences, and a source candidate qualification contract. A read-only candidate/build workflow does not deploy it or install permits. Describing the entire repository as non-executable hides this distinction; presence of the executable also does not establish active hosting.
title: Inert App and executable Host have different admission contracts
